title: ipme
tagline: Integrating Story and Sign Protocols ensures the integrity of licensing terms, making it straightforward for creators to monetize their work and for users to trust and verify IP transactions on the blockchain.
description: IPME (Intellectual Property Management Ecosystem) is a (DApp) that integrates the Story Protocol for managing and licensing intellectual properties with the Sign Protocol for attesting to the authenticity and terms of these transactions. This integration ensures a secure, transparent, and efficient system for IP creators and users.
how_its_made: I developed the smart contracts utilizing Solidity and integrated the Story Protocol and Sign Protocol to enhance functionality. For the frontend development, I chose Vue paired with Viem for a more efficient user interface. Additionally, I used Filecoin for the secure uploading and storage of any media files associated with the project.
